## BackbufferSize  (type-only)
interface BackbufferSize {
    width: number;
    height: number;
    pixelRatio: number;
}

## BootOptions  (type-only)
interface BootOptions extends SurfaceOptions {
    title?: string;
    onDeviceLost?: (info: GPUDeviceLostInfo) => void;
    forceUnsupported?: boolean;
}

## BootResult  (type-only)
type BootResult = {
    ok: true;
    surface: Surface;
    gpu: GpuContext;
    onDeviceLost(fn: (info: GPUDeviceLostInfo) => void): () => void;
} | {
    ok: false;
    reason: GpuFailureReason | 'forced';
};

## CopyResult  (type-only)
type CopyResult = 'copied' | 'manual';

interface CropInfo {

    readonly bottom: number;
}

## EmbedContext  (type-only)

## GpuContext  (type-only)
interface GpuContext {
    adapter: GPUAdapter;
    device: GPUDevice;
    context: GPUCanvasContext;
    format: GPUTextureFormat;
    timestamps: boolean;
}

## GpuFailureReason  (type-only)
type GpuFailureReason = 'no-api' | 'no-adapter' | 'no-device' | 'no-context';

## GpuInitOptions  (type-only)
interface GpuInitOptions {
    powerPreference?: GPUPowerPreference;
    onLost?: (info: GPUDeviceLostInfo) => void;
    timestamps?: boolean;
    compression?: boolean;
}

## GpuInitResult  (type-only)
type GpuInitResult = {
    ok: true;
    gpu: GpuContext;
} | {
    ok: false;
    reason: GpuFailureReason;
    detail?: string;
};

## Surface
class Surface {
    readonly root: HTMLElement;
    readonly canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;
    readonly logicalWidth: number;
    readonly logicalHeight: number;
    rect: Letterbox;
    fitRect: Letterbox;
    backbuffer: BackbufferSize;
    constructor(root: HTMLElement, opts?: SurfaceOptions);
    onResize(fn: (size: SurfaceSize) => void): () => void;
    clientToLogical(clientX: number, clientY: number, out?: Vec2): Vec2;
    logicalToClient(x: number, y: number, out?: Vec2): Vec2;
    containsLogical(p: Vec2): boolean;
    setFrame(frame: {
        x: number;
        y: number;
        width: number;
        height: number;
    } | null): void;
    layout(): void;
    destroy(): void;
}
